description:
Strategic Growth Partners provides both operations and strategic support to Tribal 8(a) and commercial organizations. Our client is a family of SBA-certified Native American Tribal 8(a) and multi-certified companies delivering IT, management consulting, and general construction solutions to the Federal Government and commercial sector.

They are seeking an experienced Information Technology Program Analyst project supports a Department of Homeland Security (DHS) component in aligning IT investments with mission priorities and supporting compliance with the Clinger-Cohen Act, Federal IT Acquisition Reform Act (FITARA), and DHS acquisition and Systems Engineering Life Cycle (SELC) requirements. This is a fulltime remote position supporting DHS program in (Eastern Time Zone) Washington, D.C. An active Secret clearance is required for this position.

The IT Program Analyst works with customers and technical teams to clarify business needs, define requirements, and prepare new IT initiatives for evaluation and planning. The analyst also supports project coordination, reporting, and portfolio oversight.

Employment Type: Full-Time. Remote

Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance.

Compensation: $120 – 135K per year.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage customers to gather and clarify business needs, desired outcomes, and requirements for new IT project requests.

  • Review requests for completeness, identify information gaps, and coordinate follow-up to define scope and support evaluation and prioritization.

  • Help translate customer needs into documented requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for backlog refinement and sprint planning.

  • Coordinate customer and project meetings; document requirements, decisions, and action items.

  • Maintain project requests, documentation, schedules, and status information in designated management systems and dashboards.

  • Support assessments of proposed IT capabilities and alignment with mission goals, portfolio priorities, and policy requirements.

  • Prepare reports, presentations, and responses to program and compliance information requests.

Required Qualifications

  • At least five years of experience supporting IT project initiation, planning, execution, and monitoring.

  • Experience gathering and documenting customer requirements and assessing IT capabilities against business needs.

  • Experience working in Scrum teams and understanding of sprints, backlog refinement, and sprint planning.

  • Experience facilitating meetings and using project management processes, dashboards, and workflows.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, including the ability to synthesize information into clear documentation.

  • Ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently and collaboratively in a virtual environment.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in information technology or a related field.

  • Experience supporting DHS IT projects and evaluating solutions against capability gaps.

  • Familiarity with DHS organizational structure, acquisition and program management processes, and project lifecycle phases.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

  • Secret security clearance.

Our client provides a variety of benefits including company-paid health, dental & vision insurance coverage, as well as additional employee-paid health insurance options; company-paid life and disability insurance; 401k retirement savings plan with employer match; 11 company paid holidays per year, and paid time off.

Our client is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This company complies with applicable federal contractor requirements regarding protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. They also provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process.
